summary: 3D-KNITTING & TECHNOLOGY AS (org. no. 920 334 504) is a private limited company (AS) based in Sykkylven, in the Brønnøysund registers since 2018-01-29. It is active with no bankruptcy or liquidation registered. Its main activity is NACE 13.960 (Produksjon av tekstiler til teknisk og industriell bruk). In its 2025 accounts (company level) operating revenue was NOK 3.9 m and net income was -NOK 542 870. CEO: Åsne Helene Folstad; board chair: Lars Einar Riksheim; auditor: REVISOR KLOKK AS.
